VoiceMailGreeting2Rep.name: VoiceMailGreeting2Rep
VoiceMailGreeting2Rep.description: Represents information about the voicemail message and its associated service rep.

IsDefault.description: Whether this is the rep's default voicemail message (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

Name.description: The name of the voicemail message.

OwnerId.description: User ID of the voicemail message owner.

OwnerType.description: The ownership type of the voicemail message. Possible values are: Owned Shared

RepId.description: ID of the rep associated with the voicemail message.

Sequence.description: The order in which the voicemail message is applied for the rep.

VoiceMailGreeting2Id.description: ID of the related VoiceMailGreeting2 record.
